general.title: Contena Services
general.description: Manage the services that are available in your Contena instance.

sw-settings-services-hero.title: Future proof your store with Contena Services
sw-settings-services-hero.intro: Services are cloud-based extensions that add specific features to your Contena store. Unlike traditional software components, services run independently of the core product and can be activated or updated without changes in the core product. They allow us to respond quickly to new needs while keeping your main system stable and streamlined.
sw-settings-services-hero.bullet-point-flexible: Highly flexible and independent from the Contena core
sw-settings-services-hero.bullet-point-scalable: Scalable and reliable for demanding workflows including AI and machine learning

index.services-are-disabled-cta: You are currently missing out on all Contena Services, including advanced AI tools and much more. Activate Contena Services to take advantage of all the current and future Services we have to offer.
index.services-scheduled: Services are scheduled to be installed and activated. This can take a moment.
index.installing-services-description: This might take a while. You will be notified as soon as the installations are complete. In the meantime you can freely use your Contena administration.

deactivate-modal.warning: Are you sure you want to deactivate “{serviceName}”?
deactivate-modal.consequences: This will result in an immediate loss of access to the Service and all associated processes.

grant-permissions.title: Unlock the full potential of Contena Services
grant-permissions.description: To deliver their full value, certain Contena Services need permissions to access key areas of your store, like product information or order data. These permissions are identical to those used by Contena extensions, and each Service only accesses the permissions it needs to function. Your data is always handled responsibly.

revoke-permissions-modal.title: Revoke permissions
revoke-permissions-modal.p-1: Are you sure you want to revoke permissions?
revoke-permissions-modal.p-2: This revokes permissions only for services that use general Services consent. Those services may be deactivated and lose related functionality.
revoke-permissions-modal.p-3: The following services are connected to Contena Account and will keep their required permissions:

deactivate-modal.title: Deactivate Contena Services
deactivate-modal.p-1: Are you sure you want to deactivate Contena Services?
deactivate-modal.p-2: This deactivates only services that use general Services consent. Services connected to Contena Account remain active.
deactivate-modal.p-3: The following services are connected to Contena Account and will remain active:

dashboard-banner.title: Introducing Contena Services
dashboard-banner.description: Transform your Contena experience into something extraordinary with our cloud-based Services that effortlessly blend into your Administration. Enjoy automatic updates and cutting-edge features, all powered by Contena, designed to elevate your business.
